usage.guide: FLUX.2 Max image generation by Black Forest Labs via Xona. Call POST https://api.xona-agent.com/image/flux-2-max with a JSON body like {"prompt":"..."}; it supports reference images per the description. CRITICAL: this endpoint only accepts payment in USDC on Solana (~$0.08/call), so the paying wallet must hold Solana USDC — a Base USDC balance will not work. Could not be verified in this run because the master Solana wallet had $0.00 (Base balance was $89.39 but is not accepted). Once Solana is funded, retry; on success read the generated image from the response body (field unconfirmed, likely image/url).
